arms.control_D2: The reconstructed adopted dense D2 training recipe, reused from dense_label_weight_v1; no control refits.
arms.short_team_2x: Same D2 training recipe and sampled windows; H/A CE frames in complete known spells <=1.0s receive multiplier 2.0; all other H/A frames receive 1.0; normalize weighted CE by known H/A weight mass in each sampled window.

candidate_weight.application: training-only conditional H/A cross-entropy; same team-symmetric rule for H and A; D loss, transition loss, inputs, sampler, optimizer, model and inference unchanged
candidate_weight.complete: known H/A run has a known H/A/D neighbor on both sides within the same full_period block; block-edge and X/unknown-censored runs are excluded
candidate_weight.inference_targets: none; labels and eligibility masks are never available at evaluation or inference
candidate_weight.normalization: sum(short_weight * existing_D2_complete_spell_factor * H/A CE) / sum(short_weight over known H/A rows) independently for each sampled window; this reproduces the D2 numerator/denominator exactly when short_weight=1

common.evaluation: reuse dense_label_weight_v1 reconstructed controls and paired 5-match x clean/corrupt_1/corrupt_2 cohort; no control refits
common.scoring: official spell-F1; equal-provider means; paired by source/match/view; individual members and native-probability average ensemble
common.train_sources: the two non-held-out old providers plus 45 SoccerNet TRAIN games; apply the same short-spell weighting rule to both sources using each record's native FPS

diagnostics_and_guards.control_replay: reused reconstructed D2 clean/feed-like aggregates must match dense_label_weight_v1 within 0.000051 before candidate scoring
diagnostics_and_guards.diagnostic: wrong-team frame-error rate inside reference possessions <=1s, with the audit's fixed grading population
diagnostics_and_guards.primary: official spell_f1_mean: global one-to-one possession spell-F1 averaged over IoU thresholds 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6 and 0.7
diagnostics_and_guards.provider_exclusion: held-out provider is excluded from every learned component and normalization in its fold

question: Does emphasizing complete dense H/A possessions lasting at most one second improve full-provider transfer team attribution?
